## Setup

```{python}
import numpy as np

from inf_bp_texts.analysis import FitModelConfig, fit_single_model
from inf_bp_texts.inference import negative_log_likelihood
from inf_bp_texts.inference.fitting import _get_crude_parameter_estimates
from inf_bp_texts.simulation import simulate_birth_death_process
```

## Simulate One Two-Epoch Dataset

```{python}
birth_rates = np.array([0.01, 0.001], dtype=float)
death_rates = np.array([0.001, 0.001], dtype=float)
times = np.array([750.0, 1500.0], dtype=float)

sim = simulate_birth_death_process(
    birth_rates=birth_rates,
    death_rates=death_rates,
    times=times,
    random_seed=42,
)
alive = sim[sim["death_time"].isna()].sort_values("is_spine", ascending=False)
ages = (times[-1] - alive["creation_time"].to_numpy(dtype=np.float64)).astype(
    np.float64
)
print(f"Population size: {len(ages)}")
print(f"First 10 ages: {ages[:10].tolist()}")
```

## Likelihood Sanity Check

```{python}
init_birth, init_death = _get_crude_parameter_estimates(ages, times)
if len(ages) > 0 and ages[0] == np.max(ages):
    spine_ages = np.array([ages[0]], dtype=np.float64)
    non_spine_ages = ages[1:]
else:
    spine_ages = None
    non_spine_ages = ages

initial_nll = negative_log_likelihood(
    birth_rates=init_birth,
    death_rates=init_death,
    ages=non_spine_ages,
    times=times,
    spine_ages=spine_ages,
    ns=None,
    is_ordered=False,
    log_scale_params=False,
)
print(f"Initial NLL: {initial_nll}")
```

## Fit and Profile One Simulation

```{python}
fit_config = FitModelConfig(
    times=times,
    is_ordered=True,
    perturb_initial_params_std=0.0,
    random_seed=10925,
    initial_birth_rates=birth_rates,
    initial_death_rates=death_rates,
)
single_fit_result = fit_single_model(ages, fit_config)
print(single_fit_result)
```

```{python}
%%prun -s cumulative -q -l 60 -T prof-multi-epoch-single-fit.txt -D prof-multi-epoch-single-fit.prof

_ = fit_single_model(ages, fit_config)
```

```{python}
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import time

doc_name = "methods_validation_multi_epoch_single_fit_debug.qmd"
project_dir = Path(os.environ.get("QUARTO_PROJECT_DIR", Path.cwd()))
compile_log = project_dir / "_output" / "compile_times.json"
compile_log.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

duration_seconds = time.perf_counter() - __compile_start
timestamp = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

try:
    data = json.loads(compile_log.read_text()) if compile_log.exists() else {}
except Exception:
    data = {}

data[doc_name] = {"duration_seconds": duration_seconds, "timestamp": timestamp}
compile_log.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2, sort_keys=True))

print(f"Render duration (non-cached): {duration_seconds:.2f}s")
```
